nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Calendula Herbal Extract Alcohol Free Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced oiliness on the forehead and less need for harsher salicylic acid toners, with one calling it good for oily skin generally.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the toner as hydrating without drying, though a couple report it caused dryness or did not resolve pre-existing dry/flaky skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report balanced hydration and reduced oiliness in some areas without drying out cheeks, with one noting occasional breakouts anyway.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most consistently report no irritation, stinging, or redness, including cases of rosacea and fragrance allergy relief, though a couple report itching or breakouts.
segments.mature: One long-term user attributes years of good skin to the product but gives no specific mature-skin detail beyond general satisfaction.

concerns.aging: One reviewer using it for menopausal skin changes reports overall calming and improvement when paired with the full Kiehl's routine, but no reviewer isolates anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the toner hydrates without stickiness or greasiness and helps dry patches; a minority report increased dryness or no hydrating benefit at all.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including several with sensitive skin or rosacea, report reduced redness and calming; one reviewer reports no improvement in redness after three weeks of use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema and reactive skin report the toner left skin soft and free of irritation where other products failed, with no dissenting barrier complaints noted.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced acne scars, more even tone, and smaller-looking pores, though one reviewer reports no improvement in uneven tone.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report calmer skin, fewer breakouts, and faster healing of pimples, including one dramatic recovery from a bad breakout; however, multiple reviewers report new breakouts after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the toner regulates excess oil and leaves skin feeling clean rather than greasy, with one noting reduced forehead oiliness specifically.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting bottle, good value per use
Shipping or freshness issues on recent orders

extraits.texte: After being so impressed with your facial moisturizer I decided to try another product. I read the description of this product and it sounded like I could benefit from it. I have uneven skin tone and redness. I used this toner, at bedtime for 3 weeks and I noticed no improvement in redness or uneven tone. Matter of fact I noticed dryness (even using the moisturizer in conjunction) and a few breakouts. I discontinued my use of this product.

Love the calendula toner, definitely works well for me (combo, acne prone). Feels like it reduces the oiliness on my forehead but doesn't dry out my cheeks, and calms breakouts - I haven't gotten much redness or inflammation at all since I started using it a few months ago! It also lasts quite a while for the cost.

This toner calms my hyper-sensitive skin and does not cause irritation or redness. I have not been able to tolerate any other brands of skin care due to my sensitivity - only the Kiehl's Calendula line. It makes my skin softer and smoother, even when don't apply moisturizer afterward. I truly love it and use it faithfully.

I love this gentle toner. It's so refreshing and moisturizing. I use it daily as the first step in my skincare regimen after cleansing and it never irritates my sensitive cheeks...mild rosacea but every toner is so harsh and drying to it except this!

I normally do not write reviews but I was recommended this product by one of my coworkers and let me tell you, this is the best toner I've laid my hands on in a while. I recently suffered a really bad break out due to my boyfriend putting tiger balm on my forehead while I was sleeping to help get rid of a headache I was having. (If you don't already know, tiger balm should definitely not be applied on the face!!) I consistently used this toner every day and night and saw a significant difference just after one day of using it!! The redness and inflammation went down so much and after 3-4 days the pimples on my forehead was barely noticeable anymore. I do suggest pairing this with an oil-free serum and moisturizer if you do suffer with acne or oily skin in general. This works wonders!!

extraits.titre: Perfect for my dry eczema skin
extraits.texte: I can't say enough good things about this toner. I have eczema and I tried many different toners, which made my skin irratated right away. Calendula Toner is alcohol-free with a lovely smell, leave my skin soft and eczema-free after using it. I have a lot of Kiehl's products and they are all very good.

i really wanted to like this but, despite having no problem with acne, i broke out both times i tried it (about 3 months apart). my skin isn't very sensitive but i know this has worked for others so still maybe worth a try!
